facts.fact: 她盘点这场仗：寄居体一拍一拍喂战术，冷铁在她手可能发抖时让准头成真——但其余的部分是她自己的。
facts.anchor: My demon passenger had fed me strategy beat by beat, and Coldiron had made my aim true when my hands might have shaken. But the rest was mine.

facts.fact: 十二年地下岁月给她锤进了学院教不出、敌人摇不动的东西。
facts.anchor: Twelve years underground had hammered something into me that no academy could teach and no enemy could shake.

facts.fact: 葬礼要等外国使团离开——他们明天就到。
facts.anchor: The funeral would have to wait until the foreign delegates were gone.

facts.fact: 出发前她想见四位继承人，可今晚不可能全见——她只能选一个。
facts.anchor: I wanted to see all four heirs before I left, but there wasn’t a version of tonight where I could go to all four. So I’d have to choose one.

facts.fact: 她自知很可能回不来，所以不能不见 Aelindor 就走。
facts.anchor: If I didn’t come back—and there was every chance I wouldn’t—I couldn’t leave without seeing Aelindor.

facts.fact: 她不肯让一个谎言继续坐在两人之间——指她与 Nikolai 的血约。
facts.anchor: I wouldn’t let a lie continue to sit between us.

facts.fact: 要塞被打了两次，睡不安稳：营火压住、夜间巡逻加倍、每个墙门都成对设哨。
facts.anchor: A fortress struck twice didn’t sleep easy.

facts.fact: 哨兵认出她却不喝止了——自外哨之后、自她带着双刃骑龙上天而他们在守墙之后，她不再是「女巫、怪胎、继承人的小项目」。
facts.anchor: None of them called out. Not anymore.

facts.fact: 章末她让黑暗与滑轮把她带向西——带向他。
facts.anchor: I let the darkness and skates carry me west, toward him.
